chunks: Perish will those who just guess and speculate,

key_terms.الْخَرَّاصُونَ: Those who guess, speculate, or rely on conjecture

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'Kharrasoon' mentioned in Surah Al-Mursalat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Al-Kharrasun' (the diviners/speculators) are often interpreted as those who rely on superficial omens or astrological conjecture rather than the clear, definitive signs of God. This verse serves as a critique of intellectual complacency, contrasting the uncertainty of human speculation with the certainty of divine revelation, a theme central to Usuli jurisprudence's emphasis on verified knowledge over mere opinion.
